verdict.rationale: Lago's own GitHub quickstart starts a matching Lago version and creates a disposable local organization for pricing illustrative requests. That gives an isolated throwaway environment that does not touch production data, but it is a local demo setup rather than a documented sandbox or test mode. missing for 10: a documented hosted sandbox/test-mode environment or separate test API keys, guidance on isolating test data from production, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: It starts the Lago version that matches this checkout, creates a disposable local organization, and prices three illustrative AI requests.
